settings.title: What makes us different
settings.content:
We understand that these pieces aren’t just jewellery – they’re symbols of love, commitment, and the moments that matter most.

As proud members of the National Association of Jewellers, we hold ourselves to the highest standards of quality and care.

Our commitment to excellence begins with 18ct gold vermeil, which is 25 times thicker than standard gold plating. We plate all our silver with rhodium, one of the rarest and most valuable metals, and apply an anti-tarnish e-coating for added protection and water resistance.

Each of our diamond simulants is meticulously hand-set, reflecting our dedication to craftsmanship.

We use ECO Packaging which is FSC® certified... and if all this wasn't enough, we offer a 2 Year Warranty for peace of mind.

settings.title: promise keepsake card
settings.content:
Every ring purchase comes with a complimentary keepsake card - a little piece of your journey.

This card is more than just a token; it's a canvas for your most cherished promises.

Whether it's a love note to your partner, a reminder of self-motivation, a bond of friendship, or a manifestation of your dreams, this keepsake is a tangible way to record and treasure your intentions.

As you wear your ring, let this card be a constant reminder of the commitments and goals that matter most to you.

Your promise, beautifully captured.

settings.text: We promise to be there for you
our customers are everything to us.

settings.content:
Every day, we pinch ourselves to believe it's real. It's an incredible honour that each of you chooses our promise rings to symbolise your special commitments.

Knowing that our rings are part of your meaningful moments fills us with gratitude.

Thank you for trusting us with something so personal and important. It means the world to us.
